name: com.platequery/plate-api
description: License plate lookup API for AI agents, built on PlateQuery: read messages other people left about a vehicle -- reporting bad driving, illegal parking, or a note for the owner -- plus public ALPR (automated license plate reader) sighting history from Flock Safety cameras, by U.S. state or region. OAuth 2.1 (PKCE + dynamic client registration) -- sign in with your PlateQuery account, no manual API key needed.
title: PlateQuery MCP — US License Plate & Vehicle Information
